snippet.title: The Grip of Madness - Convention Reel 2022
snippet.description:
The world is in danger! Eldritch Horrors are invading and it’s up to you and your friends to stop the invasion and clean up the mess! But be careful who you trust! 

—

This was our convention reel video updated for GDEX/Origins 2022! 

Wishlist the game on Steam! Gripofmadness.com
